Being within 15 meters of 3 Enemies grants <enhanced/>${140*#d-100}% increased damage. Buff lingers for 1.5 seconds once the condition is no longer met.

Exceptions:
• Swords only receive a <enhanced/>${135*#d-100}% damage increase.
• Grenade and Rocket Launchers receive a <enhanced/>${135*#d-100}% Explosive Damage increase and a <enhanced/>${140*#d-100}% Impact Damage increase.
• Wolfpack Rounds receive a <enhanced/>${135*#d-100}% Explosive Damage increase.
